components.heading: Failure to redeem.
components.text: If an impounded dog, cat or miniature pot-belly pig is not redeemed within the 72-hour detention period set forth in TMC 6.15.140 , then said animal shall be deemed abandoned and title thereto shall pass to the humane society by operation of law. (Ord. 20106 § 33, 12-19-17.)
